hero.title: TokenMaxxing: How to Get the Most Out of Your AI Models
hero.description: AI companies charge by the token, and most people burn them on jobs a cheap model could do. Here's how to spend less and get better results, from your first prompt to your first agent.

latest.description: Kelly Schultz bought a pumpkin farm in 1996. He transformed it into a seasonal attraction that draws in 100,000 visitors each fall.

latest.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
latest.description: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.

latest.title: Berkshire shares buck market sell-off, rally to highest since Buffett said he would step down as CEO
latest.description: Berkshire Hathaway shares are at their highest level since Warren Buffett told shareholders at the May 2025 annual meeting he planned to step down as CEO at the end of that year.

latest.title: Bending Spoons wants to revive software castoffs. Berkshire is backing the plan
latest.description: Less than four months into life as a public company, Bending Spoons got a big vote of confidence this week from Berkshire Hathaway.

latest.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
latest.description: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

latest.title: Trump waives broad new Russia sanctions and tariffs under Graham Act, citing national interest
latest.description: Trump signed the Graham Bill, which targeted Russia over its invasion of Ukraine, into law in September.

latest.title: Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
latest.description: Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.

latest.title: Lagarde says euro-area economy is resilient, digital euro imminent
latest.description: “The digital euro will further stimulate innovation and competition in retail payments,” according to the ECB president.

latest.title: Bitget to discontinue services for some users in one-off exercise
latest.description: Bitget says user funds are safe and exchange will continue to operate during the change.

latest.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
latest.description: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

latest.title: Some companies give AI to everyone. This CEO is doing the opposite
latest.description: Paysend CEO Ben Chisell limits AI tools to top performers as other U.K. companies push broader workplace rollouts.

latest.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
latest.description: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

latest.title: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year
latest.description: The Treasury Department published the U.S. budget deficit for the 2026 fiscal year.

latest.title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
latest.description: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.

latest.title: Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo puts the company's status-symbol power to the test
latest.description: Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo is drawing early demand as analysts assess whether the foldable can lift iPhone pricing and revenue.

latest.title: 5 midterm money takeaways: Democrats have candidate cash. Republicans have Elon Musk

latest.title: Katie Zacharia out as Trump's White House press secretary

latest.description: Ukrainian officials complained this week that SpaceX had limited internet connectivity without advance notice.
